categories.name: AI & Automation

categories.name: Banking & Neobanking

categories.question: What transactions, permissions and support do you need?

categories.name: Budgeting & FinanceOps
categories.summary: Make spending, cash visibility and planning routines consistent.
categories.question: Which decisions depend on a reliable cash view?
categories.watchFor: Understand data freshness, forecast assumptions and approval controls.

categories.name: Business Credit
categories.summary: Organize business credit records and education before evaluating any product or service.
categories.question: Which records and reporting sources are relevant to the business?
categories.watchFor: Avoid promises of score changes, tradelines or funding approval.

categories.name: CRM & Sales
categories.summary: Track customer conversations, ownership and follow-up in one working process.
categories.question: What must a team remember after every customer interaction?
categories.watchFor: Test data export, permissions and the cost of maintaining clean records.

categories.name: E-commerce
categories.summary: Compare storefront and commerce operations against catalog, fulfillment and customer needs.
categories.question: Where do orders, inventory and support break down today?
categories.watchFor: Check platform fees, portability and integration scope in current terms.

categories.name: Financing
categories.summary: Locate service pathways around capital preparation; detailed product education belongs to Funding.
categories.question: What use of funds, timing and repayment capacity can be documented?
categories.watchFor: No directory listing determines eligibility, pricing or approval.

categories.name: HR & Payroll
categories.summary: Coordinate hiring, pay administration and employee records with clear responsibility.
categories.question: Which payroll and people tasks need an accountable owner?
categories.watchFor: Verify jurisdiction, tax and employment requirements with qualified advisors.

categories.name: Insurance & Benefits
categories.summary: Map protection and benefits needs before reviewing policy or plan terms.
categories.question: Which people, assets and interruptions need protection?
categories.watchFor: Coverage, exclusions and premiums require current licensed-provider documents.

categories.name: Legal & Compliance
categories.summary: Find the right professional and operational process for obligations and records.
categories.question: Which decision has a legal, licensing or filing consequence?
categories.watchFor: Directory guidance is not legal advice; confirm scope and credentials directly.

categories.name: Marketing & SEO
categories.summary: Evaluate channels and measurement before buying campaigns or software.
categories.question: Which audience, offer and conversion event can you define?
categories.watchFor: Ask how results are attributed and what work remains yours after an engagement.

categories.name: Payments & POS
categories.summary: Review how sales are accepted, reconciled and handled when transactions fail.
categories.question: Where does a payment become an order, refund or ledger entry?
categories.watchFor: Check current processing terms, hardware needs and dispute responsibilities.

categories.name: Productivity
categories.summary: Organize work, handoffs and knowledge without adding unnecessary tool sprawl.
categories.question: What information must move between people and tasks?
categories.watchFor: Prioritize ownership, access control and exportability over feature lists.

categories.name: Real Estate Services
categories.summary: Coordinate property-related specialists, records and transactions by use case.
categories.question: What property, location and transaction stage define the need?
categories.watchFor: Verify local licensing, scope and transaction-specific terms.

categories.name: Social Media & Content
categories.summary: Plan publishing and community work around a defined audience and evidence of response.
categories.question: What will the content help a customer understand or do?
categories.watchFor: Separate audience growth claims from attributable business outcomes.

collections.name: Cash visibility

collections.decision: Reconcile current records before using forecasts or considering external capital.

collections.name: Team and controls
collections.summary: Make people, permissions and operating risk visible as a business grows.
collections.decision: Assign responsibility and confirm legal requirements before automating a process.
